validate-azure-ad-token.failed-validation-error-message: Unauthorized. Present an Entra ID access token issued for the KMS gateway API (api://__GATEWAY_APP_ID__).

return-response.set-body: @(new JObject( new JProperty("error", "insufficient_role"), new JProperty("operation", context.Operation.Id), new JProperty("requiredAnyOf", (string)context.Variables["requiredRoles"]), new JProperty("callerRoles", (string)context.Variables["callerRoles"]), new JProperty("callerObjectId", ((Jwt)context.Variables["jwt"]).Claims.GetValueOrDefault("oid", "")), new JProperty("requestId", context.RequestId.ToString()) ).ToString())

@(new JObject( new JProperty("error", "private_link_required"), new JProperty("message", "This API only accepts traffic that arrives through the API Management private endpoint."), new JProperty("clientIp", context.Request.IpAddress), new JProperty("requestId", context.RequestId.ToString()) ).ToString())
